content.short: Atrium is a Cardano social platform with customizable NFT accounts, identity, reputation, and profile data.
content.description: Atrium is a Cardano social-media project built around customizable NFT-based accounts. User accounts are designed as tradable profile NFTs that can be leveled up, personalized, and read by smart contracts as part of the platform experience. The project connects on-chain identity with social interaction, giving users a way to represent themselves, build reputation, and participate in a network where profile data can become part of the Cardano application layer. Atrium's focus is portable identity for Cardano-native communities.
